verdict.rationale: CloudConvert offers multi-task jobs and a Job Builder, so asking whether automations can be versioned, reviewed, and rolled back is a fair question for this product. The evidence shows nothing about job or workflow version history, review, or rollback. Pinning a fixed LibreOffice engine version is a different control and earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
